Under BUN_VERSION 1.3.11 and, for adapter, Node 26.12.1. baseline: the median of the runs. ceiling: the worst CI run plus a 10% margin (worst × 1.10), since a handful of samples can understate the spread. A run whose judged ratio is above its ceiling is REGRESSED. catches: ceiling ÷ baseline, so the gate catches a regression beyond +X% of the CI median. A reportOnly scenario is printed and never fails the run; its reason says why; a gated scenario's reason says what its ceiling covers.
